name: Eiganjo
description: Eiganjo, also called Eiganjo Castle or the Imperial Palace, is the Imperial city and palace of Kamigawa where Kaito and Eiko grew up and the emperor lives.

bio.text: In the first episode, Kaito sneaks into the palace kitchen to steal blue mochi, spars with the emperor without knowing her at first, and refuses to be a samurai when Light-Paws tells him he must choose a path.

bio.text: An alarm sounds and Kaito finds Kyodai in distress and the emperor missing, and he resolves to leave the palace and search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm after the Imperials blame the Uprisers.

bio.text: Kaito, Tamiyo and the emperor return to the emperor's garden in Eiganjo, where Tamiyo places the Reality Chip on the emperor's hand, and the emperor orders the court to prepare against the Uprisers and agrees to remain in Eiganjo.

bio.text: The Uprisers breach Eiganjo's gates, Tezzeret takes control of the chip on Tamiyo's hand and drags her away through a portal, and Kaito knocks Risona unconscious so she is bound, ending the battle.

bio.text: The emperor names Light-Paws her proxy and vanishes from Kamigawa again, and Kaito says goodbye to Eiko and leaves to master planeswalking.

bio.text: A later story shows Norika rising to chief handler of the merge in Eiganjo, and the Kamigawa profile calls it Konda's stronghold.

citations.text: "The Foes Who Make Us". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Feb 2022.
"Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

status.text: As of the last events, Eiganjo is under Light-Paws as Regent of Kamigawa after the Uprisers' attack was beaten back, and the Kamigawa profile has Konda remaining safe within his stronghold.

timeline.summary: Only Eiganjo Castle stands after the kami strike.
timeline.quote: Only Eiganjo Castle remained standing, glistening untouched in the sun.

citation.text: Stone Rain (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An emperor dies without an heir and Eiganjo falls into war over succession.
timeline.quote: With no guidance, Eiganjo descended into all-out war

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Shattered States era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A young Yamazaki soldier assassinates the late emperor's husband but is confronted by the brother.
timeline.quote: He successfully assassinated the late emperor's husband

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Shattered States era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kyodai strips the Konda family of their hereditary rule; future rulers will be elected by the kami.
timeline.quote: She stripped the Konda family of their hereditary duty as rulers.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Shattered States era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa steals The Taken One from Eiganjo and performs a ritual to free the spirit, who takes the name Kyodai.
timeline.quote: took the name Kyodai, meaning "sibling."

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the night of Michiko's birth, Lady Pearl-Ear informs Lord Konda, who seems uninterested.
timeline.quote: The story starts on the night of Michiko's birth.

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Prologue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Years later, Michiko, Choryu and Riko escape Eiganjo Castle but are separated and tricked into the kitsune village by Sharp-Ear.
timeline.quote: They manage to leave the castle

citation.text: "Outlaw: Champions of Kamigawa", section "Part I". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pearl-Ear is exiled from Eiganjo, finds her village burned by the akki army and learns the kitsune have severed ties with Konda.
timeline.quote: The kitsune have severed their ties with Konda as he clearly can't protect them anymore.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo and the refugees run into the akki army.
timeline.quote: then O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu's forces kill Keiga; at Eiganjo O-Kagachi bites Yosei in half and Takeno dies protecting Konda; Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken, making O-Kagachi disappear.
timeline.quote: Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken and teleports out, making O-Kagachi disappear.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Isamaru and the wounded Yosei rally the soldiers while an army of twisted ghosts led by a misshapen Takeno rises to aid Konda.
timeline.quote: the appearance of Isamaru and the hurt-but-still-fighting Yosei rallies them.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi descends on Eiganjo Castle, rips Yosei in half and ruins the castle.
timeline.quote: One of O-Kagachi's heads caught Yosei in its jaws and ripped him in half

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa teleports into Konda's sanctum and steals the Taken One during the chaos.
timeline.quote: He stole the Taken One from the pedestal

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi senses the Taken One's absence and retreats, leaving Konda's kingdom in ruins.
timeline.quote: leaving in its wake the ruins of Konda's kingdom

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Attack on Eiganjo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takeno commands the archers at Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: Do not let a single shaft loose until my word.

citation.text: Hail of Arrows (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Isamaru attacks Toshi at Eiganjo and Toshi teleports him to Jukai.
timeline.quote: he is attacked by Isamaru

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito sneaks into the palace kitchen and uses telekinesis to steal blue mochi, escaping a cook after breaking dishes.
timeline.quote: Two pieces of mochi floated up in the air, hovering inches above the table.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito shares a mochi with Eiko in the sparring room before Light-Paws arrives.
timeline.quote: "Don't be mad."

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws announces Kaito and Eiko will no longer be sparring partners, because Eiko has chosen to study as a kami diplomat.
timeline.quote: Eiko has chosen to study as a kami diplomat.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito recalls how he first befriended the emperor, speaking to her behind a screen door without knowing who she was.
timeline.quote: Kaito hadn't known it was the emperor.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Swift-Arm introduces Kaito's new sparring partner, who is the emperor, and Kaito sees her face for the first time.
timeline.quote: The Emperor of Kamigawa.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito spars with the emperor and she disarms him, smiling in recognition.
timeline.quote: held both wooden blades to his neck before he even had time to steady himself.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Katsumasa, a Futurist, meets Kaito in a palace garden, sends a crane drone, and gives Kaito one.
timeline.quote: "Here. From one person the system failed to another."

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito tells Katsumasa that his parents died after the lab accident and the unapproved med-tech.
timeline.quote: "My dad was arrested. He died in prison, and my mom died not long after."

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws tells Kaito there will be no more sparring lessons and that he must choose a path, and Kaito refuses to be a samurai.
timeline.quote: "I don't want to be a samurai,"

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws reveals the emperor told her of Kaito's ideas, and Kaito turns his back on his mentor.
timeline.quote: "What you mean," Kaito replied bitterly, "is that I have no place here."

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: An alarm sounds in the palace and Kaito races over the rooftops to the emperor's chambers.
timeline.quote: Kaito took the fastest route to the emperor's chambers.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds Kyodai writhing in distress and the emperor missing.
timeline.quote: But now Kyodai writhed in the water, lashing at the fog like she was hurting and confused.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito sees the man with the metal arm rise from the fog beside Kyodai.
timeline.quote: and a metal arm that pulsed with purple energy, the ends forming a monstrous claw.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito chases the intruder over the rooftops, but the man uses power over technology to yank Kaito from the roof and escapes.
timeline.quote: Kaito felt his wrist tug, and then he was yanked from the roof

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito discovers the emperor is gone, and the Imperials blame the Uprisers.
timeline.quote: he realized the emperor was gone, too.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws suggests the Futurists are responsible and refuses to listen to Kaito's account.
timeline.quote: "Perhaps the Futurists are responsible for this.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws orders Kaito to his room, and Kaito resolves to leave the palace and search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm.
timeline.quote: He would search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm.

citation.text: "Episode 1: A Stranger in Eiganjo" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Tamiyo, and the emperor arrive in the emperor's garden in Eiganjo, and the emperor enters Kyodai's temple.
timeline.quote: She turned for the porch, slid open the door to Kyodai's temple, and disappeared inside.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo find Kyodai reunited with the emperor, both in pain from the emperor's unstable spark.
timeline.quote: "Your spark is still unstable. You cannot remain on Kamigawa without help."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo places the Reality Chip on the emperor's hand and it fuses to her flesh, stabilizing her for a time.
timeline.quote: the wires fused to her flesh like veins pulsing with energy.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor reveals she has visions of the lab and that Jin-Gitaxias told Risona and the Uprisers of her return, so they will attack the palace.
timeline.quote: They plan to attack the palace imminently.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor tells Kaito she heard of his search across the planes and nearly met him many times.
timeline.quote: "Sometimes I was only a step behind you.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws and Eiko arrive and bow to the emperor, who orders the court to prepare against the Uprisers.
timeline.quote: We must prepare our forces at once."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo urges destroying the Reality Chip, but Kaito objects and proposes destroying Tameshi's lab with Imperial detonators.
timeline.quote: "I'll destroy Tameshi's compound."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor approves the plan to destroy the compound, and agrees to remain in Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: "I will remain here," she said at last.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito promises the emperor to free any captive kami before setting off the charge.
timeline.quote: "You have my word," Kaito replied.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer has a vision of the ambush and decides to planeswalk into the compound, with Eiko encouraging her to save Kaito.
timeline.quote: "They were ambushed by Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Using her bond with Kyodai to stabilize her spark, the Wanderer planeswalks to Tameshi's compound.
timeline.quote: the Wanderer planeswalked out of Eiganjo and into Tameshi's compound with a flash of light.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kyodai warns the Wanderer through the bond that Risona has brought an army to Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: Risona has brought an army.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Uprisers have breached Eiganjo's gates as the mech arrives.
timeline.quote: Risona and the Asari Uprisers had indeed come to Eiganjo—and they'd already breached the gates.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret wakes and flings Kaito's smoke devices, then jumps from the mech; Tamiyo loses control and the group jumps before the mech crashes.
timeline.quote: the mech exploding against the side of an Imperial apartment.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo track Tezzeret as he heads for the emperor and fight him on the rooftops, with Eiko's dagger striking him.
timeline.quote: In his thigh was a gleaming dagger, the gold handle carved with the symbol of the Imperials.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the chip on Tamiyo's hand, opens a portal and drags her away.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret yanked Tamiyo through the snapping light, and they both vanished from the rooftop.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer fights Risona in Kyodai's temple and offers her surrender.
timeline.quote: "Drop your blade. There is no need for you to die this way."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks Risona unconscious with a thrown rock and she is bound, ending the battle.
timeline.quote: something flew across the room and cracked against the side of her skull, knocking her unconscious.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: With her spark destabilizing, the emperor names Light-Paws her proxy to rule Kamigawa with Kyodai's blessing.
timeline.quote: "You will be my proxy, and rule Kamigawa for as long as I am unable."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor's spark takes hold and she vanishes from Kamigawa again.
timeline.quote: The spark took hold of her, and the emperor once again vanished from Kamigawa.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws grows a new tail and Kaito and Eiko bow to the new Regent of Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: Kaito and his sister bowed to the new Regent of Kamigawa.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito says goodbye to Eiko, promising someday to try to reconcile with Light-Paws, and leaves to master planeswalking and find Tamiyo and the emperor.
timeline.quote: He would search the Multiverse for Tamiyo.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: As children, Norika and Heiko sneak to the tea garden to see a merge, and a faceless kami emerges and attacks.
timeline.quote: Something is shouldering its way through the gap.

citation.text: "The Foes Who Make Us". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Norika throws herself between the kami and Heiko and is struck by a beam of pain, leaving her paralyzed for years.
timeline.quote: She leaps, but never lands.

citation.text: "The Foes Who Make Us". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Norika's recovery and rise, from the Imperial medics to chief handler of the merge in Eiganjo, culminating in Naomi sending her to command in Sokenzanshi.
timeline.quote: "The bandit problem in Sokenzanshi has gotten out of hand. I need you to take command there."

citation.text: "The Foes Who Make Us". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: A Yamazaki soldier assassinates the late emperor's husband during a succession civil war, and Kyodai strips the Konda family of its right to rule.
timeline.quote: She stripped the Konda family of their hereditary duty as rulers.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "The Shattered States era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Konda remains mysteriously safe within his stronghold throughout the siege.
timeline.quote: Throughout this siege, Konda remained within his stronghold, mysteriously safe from harm.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
